# Lydia Opens Her Home (Acts 16:15)

## Emotional Focus
Opening your home so others can hear about Jesus.

## Key KJV
“If ye have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house, and abide there.” (Acts 16:15)

## Gentle Retelling
Lydia believed in Jesus and immediately opened her home to Paul and his friends. Her house became a happy place for God’s people.

## Coloring Prompt
Lydia welcoming Paul and friends into her home with a warm smile.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Our home can be a place where people meet Jesus.”
